title: Pure Blue-Eyes
summary: Blue-Eyes and the cards built around Blue-Eyes White Dragon, with generic staples. The page's combo lines add Dracoverlord Rituals and Deep-Eyes White Dragon, which isn't out in the TCG until 12 November, so they use cards this list leaves out. Sage with Eyes of Blue, Maiden of White and the 2025 support (Wishes, Roar and Neo Kaiser Sea Horse) find and summon Blue-Eyes White Dragon; the Extra Deck stays all Dragons, because Roar and Spirit with Eyes of Blue lock you into them.

allow.Chaos Form: Ritual Spell for Blue-Eyes Chaos MAX Dragon, banishing Blue-Eyes White Dragon as material.
allow.Ultimate Fusion: Fusion Spell for monsters that list Blue-Eyes White Dragon.
allow.Hieratic Seal of the Heavenly Spheres: Generic Dragon Link-2 the page lists for Blue-Eyes.

main: Blue-Eyes White Dragon
The card everything searches, summons and Fuses.
Blue-Eyes Alternative White Dragon
Special Summons itself by revealing Blue-Eyes White Dragon, counts as it, and destroys a monster.
Blue-Eyes Jet Dragon
Protects your other cards from destruction, and returns from the hand or GY whenever a card is destroyed.
Sage with Eyes of Blue
Normal Summoned: searches a Level 1 LIGHT Tuner; discards to send a monster to the GY and summon a Blue-Eyes from the Deck.
Maiden of White
Places True Light from the hand, Deck or GY, and comes back when you summon Blue-Eyes White Dragon.
Neo Kaiser Sea Horse
Special Summons itself next to Blue-Eyes White Dragon; leaving the field, sends a Blue-Eyes card from the Deck to the GY.
Dictator of D.
Sends Blue-Eyes White Dragon from the Deck to summon itself, then revives a Blue-Eyes from the GY.
Blue-Eyes Abyss Dragon
Special Summoned: searches a Ritual Spell or Polymerization; at the End Phase, searches a Level 8 Dragon.
The White Stone of Legend
Sent to the GY: searches Blue-Eyes White Dragon.
The White Stone of Ancients
Sent to the GY this turn: summons a Blue-Eyes from the Deck at the End Phase.
Blue-Eyes Chaos MAX Dragon
Ritual with Chaos Form: untargetable, indestructible by their effects, and double piercing damage.
Wishes for Eyes of Blue
Discards to search a Level 1 LIGHT Tuner and a Spell/Trap that mentions Blue-Eyes White Dragon.
Roar of the Blue-Eyed Dragons
Summons a Blue-Eyes from the Deck, GY or banishment; from the GY, Fusion Summons with a Blue-Eyes.
Mausoleum of White
Field Spell fetched by Spirit with Eyes of Blue: an extra Normal Summon for a Level 1 LIGHT Tuner.
Chaos Form
Ritual Spell for Blue-Eyes Chaos MAX Dragon.
Ultimate Fusion
Quick-Play Fusion for a Blue-Eyes Fusion, then destroys cards for each Blue-Eyes White Dragon used from the field.
True Light
Placed by Maiden of White: shields Blue-Eyes White Dragon from targeting, and summons it or Sets a card that names it.
Majesty of the White Dragons
Shows up to three Blue-Eyes White Dragons to destroy as many cards; from the GY, Ritual Summons with them.
extra: Spirit with Eyes of Blue
Link-1: fetches Mausoleum of White, and Tributes itself to summon a Blue-Eyes.
Blue-Eyes Spirit Dragon
Level 9: stops multiple summons and GY effects, and tags out into a LIGHT Dragon Synchro.
Blue-Eyes Ultimate Spirit Dragon
Level 12 for two Tuners and a Blue-Eyes: negates activations on the field.
Azure-Eyes Silver Dragon
Level 9 for a Tuner and Normal Monsters: protects your Dragons, and revives Blue-Eyes White Dragon each Standby Phase.
Blue-Eyes Tyrant Dragon
Fusion of Blue-Eyes White Dragon and a Dragon: unaffected by Traps, and attacks every monster.
Neo Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon
Fusion of three Blue-Eyes White Dragons: negates and destroys on either turn, and attacks again.
Blue-Eyes Alternative Ultimate Dragon
Fusion of three: can't be targeted or destroyed by their effects, and destroys cards.
Blue-Eyes Twin Burst Dragon
Fusion of two Blue-Eyes White Dragons: two attacks, and banishes what survives them.
Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon
The original Fusion of three Blue-Eyes White Dragons.
Dragon Master Magia
Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon or three Blue-Eyes plus a Chaos Ritual: negates one card of each type per turn.
Hieratic Seal of the Heavenly Spheres
Dragon Link-2: bounces a face-up card on the opponent's turn.
Crimson Dragon
Level 12 Synchro that swaps into a Dragon Synchro of the same Level on either turn.
Number 38: Hope Harbinger Dragon Titanic Galaxy
Generic Rank 8 Dragon from two Blue-Eyes: negates a Spell on either turn.
